summary: This standards-track memo defines a negative acknowledgement mechanism for Signaling Compression (SigComp). When a compressed message cannot be decompressed, the receiver can report precise error information, which the sender can use to adjust its compression.

eli5.summary: If you cannot understand a message, you tell the sender exactly what went wrong. This lets compressed messages be fixed or resent more cleverly.

questions: what happens when sigcomp decompression fails
